انبثقن (form VII)
# اِنْبَثَقْنَ (inbaṯaqna) /in.ba.θaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# اِنْبَثِقْنَ (inbaṯiqna) /in.ba.θiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
